name: RAMSSOL
recent: Ramssol 在 2026 年第三季度净利按年增长 25.4% 至 935 万令吉，主要来自 Innio Group 收购与 AiTech 业务增长。同期，公司因行使凭单 A 多次发行新股，大股东 Urusharta Jamaah 及董事 Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng 的持股出现变动。
notable: 2026 年第三季度净利按年增长 25.4% 至 935 万令吉，受 Innio Group 收购与 AiTech 增长带动。
公司因行使凭单 A 多次发行新股，涉及 50,000 至 500,000 股不等。
大股东 Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd 及董事 Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng 的持股出现变动。
risks: 凭单 A 持续转换导致股本逐步扩大。
董事在闭门期内有交易意向，并在闭门期外进行了股份收购。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 2,728 万令吉，按年增长 50.6%，按季增长 22.9%；净利为 742.9 万令吉，按年增长 27.2%，按季增长 14.3%；净利率为 27.2%，低于上一季度的 29.3%。

recent_en: Ramssol's 3Q26 net profit rose 25.4% year-on-year to RM9.35 million, driven by the Innio Group acquisition and AiTech growth. During the period, the company issued new shares from multiple Warrant-A conversions, with shareholding changes by substantial shareholder Urusharta Jamaah and Director Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng.
notable_en: 3Q26 net profit rose 25.4% year-on-year to RM9.35 million, driven by the Innio Group acquisition and AiTech growth.
The company issued new shares from multiple Warrant-A conversions, ranging from 50,000 to 500,000 shares.
Shareholding changes occurred for substantial shareholder Urusharta Jamaah Sdn Bhd and Director Datuk Wira Tan Chee Seng.
risks_en: Ongoing Warrant-A conversions gradually enlarge the share base.
A director indicated intention to deal during the closed period and acquired shares outside the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM27.28 million, up 50.6% year-on-year and 22.9% quarter-on-quarter; net income was RM7.429 million, up 27.2% year-on-year and 14.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 27.2%, lower than 29.3% in the previous quarter.
